name: Seijun Idol ga Ochiru Made
original_name: 清純アイドルが堕ちるまで
source:
This is a short novel where an idol is hypnotized to be a pervert so that she exposes herself in misery.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ223151.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
一部短篇小说，讲述一位偶像遭到催眠，被变成淫荡变态，狼狈地暴露身体。

[引自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ223151.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite英文版[/url]]
